BrochureContent.Content:
Detached Residence

Substantial c.3,000sqft detached partly-refurbished residence requiring completion located a 15 minute walk from Rosscarbery.

Enjoying a private and sheltered sunny plot of c.0.45 Acre with mature gardens and outbuildings, this exciting restorative project offers huge potential to re-design and re-purpose.

The original residence features a vernacular stone farmhouse, itself modernised and extended some years ago with a large wing doubling the living space and incorporating an internal garage.

Accommodation includes an entrance hall, large kitchen/dining room, 2 reception rooms, guest wc and a fantastic South facing conservatory.

Overhead are 4 bedrooms, 3 ensuite and a office/store room with shower room in the attic.

Externally the property is accessed via a tarmacadam and features a selection of lawn gardens, mature shrubberies and hardwood native trees.

Its proximity to Rosscarbery being just a 15 min walk along with the nearby attractions of Glandore, Unionhall and the Warren Beach ensure everything on its doorstep including schools, public transport, bars, restaurants, shops etc…

Services; Mains Water & Private Well, Private Drainage, Oil Heating, Broadband
